post.description: Using a token pushes its deadline back: a player who plays never sees the form again, an abandoned machine stops opening sessions on its own. Unknown, revoked and expired tokens all answer alike.
post.summary: Reopen a session from a device token

post.description: The token is returned once and only once: the server keeps nothing but its digest. Store it on the device and present it to /api/auth/session on later starts, so the password is never asked again. Opens a session too, so a first sign-in is a single round trip.
